title: What Happens When a Whale Dies Two Miles Down
title_options: The Boss Drop That Lasts a Century
A Whale Just Died. Here's What Eats It for 100 Years.
youtube_description:
Right now, about two miles under the Pacific, something the size of a school bus is lying dead on the seafloor — and it's about to feed an ecosystem for the next hundred years. Some of the things eating it don't even have mouths.

This is the full story of a whale fall: the scavengers, the bone-eating worms with no gut, the sulphur bacteria that run for decades, and the 485-whale graveyard scientists only announced this June. Then we answer the question with 5,000 likes under every whale-fall video: what happens to the deep sea when whaling takes the whales away?

{CHAPTERS}

Every claim in this video is sourced — sources below. This is the channel's first weekly long-form episode, narrated in Courtney's own voice; 3 Shorts are cut from it this week.
